study: Retrospective same previously observed source failure event; evaluation-only comparison
preprocessing: Original matched quantization, before continuous causal injection; no re-quantization after injection
calibration: Each model has one score, calibrated on the same 120 NORMAL record maxima, p=(1+count(cal>=score))/121
source_exposure: Historical failure data and historical comparator results were known before this audit; this is not a blinded preregistration

knn.additional_feature_scaling: normal fit mean and population SD

ridge.input: up to five prior rows of all three standardized sensors
ridge.score: maximum absolute residual / respective training residual SD
ridge.alpha_choice: minimum lag-5 MSE on normal FIT last20%, trained on FIT first80%; grid order breaks ties

injections.denominator: every normal test record; only onset-and-later rows count as hits/control hits

bootstrap.method: Stratified circular moving recording-block bootstrap; same sampled record IDs across models
bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile 95%, no retuning or recalibration in resamples
bootstrap.interpretation: Within-event conditional variability only; overlapping A/B are not replications; no independent failure generalization
bootstrap.zero_included: No superiority or equivalence conclusion; retain existing selection
bootstrap.excludes_zero: Describe directional difference only within this observed event; retain existing selection

operational_properties_frozen_before_run.V2: causal, deterministic, first-row availability, component-level explanation
operational_properties_frozen_before_run.V2+VD3@1: causal, deterministic, first-row availability through V2, separate vibration residual indication
operational_properties_frozen_before_run.5NN_feature_matched: causal, deterministic, first-row availability with fit-median fill, retained training reference rows
operational_properties_frozen_before_run.RidgeForecast_3channel: causal, deterministic, first row unavailable, three-channel prediction residuals

rules: No R1/R2/persistence or new operational rule; no candidate reselection
